tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Avahit's catalog of Amazon products by brand and category. Returns title, store domain and a link to the product page on Avahit. Amazon prices are not returned: the current price is on Amazon, and Avahit keeps no Amazon price history.

tools.name: compare_alternatives
tools.description: Given an Avahit product id, return ranked alternatives with a match percentage explaining how close each one is (same category, price distance, product type, same store).
